tool.name: AddBooleanAccessRestrictionsFields
tool.summary: Parse the JSON-encoded access_restrictions column of Overture segment features and add individual boolean fields indicating whether access is denied for each transportation mode (e.g. access_denied_when_mode_foot, access_denied_when_mode_car). Each field is set to 1 when the mode is restricted and 0 otherwise.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must contain an access_restrictions field with JSON-encoded restriction data from Overture Maps segment features.
Boolean fields are created for every unique access mode found across all features.
This tool is designed for segment features downloaded from Overture Maps.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The segment feature layer or feature class containing an access_restrictions column to parse into boolean fields.
